name: Deep Ocean Resin
note: Tinted epoxy field in deep ocean #08283A. Depth over decoration.

name: Obsidian Resin
note: Near-black field #080A0E. Use when the room already has light.

name: Sapphire Resin
note: Cool sapphire #164E6B. Holds under indoor light.

name: Champagne Veil Resin
note: Muted champagne gold #B89B63 as a veil, not a glitter.

name: Clear Casting Resin
note: Low-tint clear for figured timber. Yellowing behaviour to be confirmed per batch.

name: Storm Grey Resin
note: Neutral grey for offices that refuse blue.

name: Monsoon Green Resin
note: Deep green with low metallic. Forest and monsoon collections.

name: Mineral Amber Resin
note: Warm amber for earth and geode pairings.

name: Aurora Shift Resin
note: Two-tint pour; do not promise a hologram.

name: Smoke Resin
note: Translucent charcoal for midnight edges.

name: Botanical Embedding Resin
note: Clear system chosen for inclusions. No archive-permanence claim.

name: Indian Walnut
note: Dark furniture walnut when available. Grain is the drawing.

name: American Black Walnut
note: Imported walnut only when the brief needs it and supply exists.

name: White Oak
note: Pale, quiet grain under clear or smoke resin.

name: Teak

name: Sheesham / Indian Rosewood

name: Ash

name: Mango
note: Local, lively grain; better in secondary objects than banquet tables.

name: Reclaimed Teak
note: Character and holes; resin as repair and drawing.

name: Burned / Charred Oak
note: Black surface against a quiet resin line.

name: Live-Edge Slab

name: Mild Steel Welded Frame

name: Stainless Base

name: Bronze-Tone Base

name: Brass Inlay

name: Kota or Local Stone

name: Marble Sample Pairing
